khai.tagline: Proxemics as process: the regulation of the physical distance a persona keeps from other persons -- the portable bubble whose size encodes the relationship -- across the zone, intrusion, and equilibrium forms.

card.wire: Attaches at Process. The root (process_proxemics.md) declares proxemics as the regulation of interpersonal distance: a persona carries a portable bubble of personal space and holds others at a distance that encodes the relationship -- the closer the tie, the closer the body allowed -- reading and setting closeness through the gap between persons rather than through any claim on a place. The law makes the distance kept a signal and a boundary in its own right.
card.issue: Three forms the distance-regulation takes. Zone: the graded distances that encode the relationship -- intimate, personal, social, and public bands, each admitting a different degree of tie, so how near a persona stands says how close they are. Intrusion: the encroachment of another into the bubble -- the too-close body that triggers discomfort, arousal, and the urge to flee or restore the gap, personal space felt only when it is breached. Equilibrium: the mutual regulation of closeness -- distance traded against gaze, angle, and other intimacy signals so the total stays comfortable, one persona's approach met by the other's compensating pull-back.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. The link: each persona links, under Projection, the form the moment runs -- and therefore how the distance is working, as a zone that signals the tie, an intrusion that breaches the bubble, or an equilibrium that trades distance against other intimacy.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared and each persona links a real form of proxemics. Whether the distance is true to the scene -- a genuine interpersonal gap encoding a genuine tie, the zone or the intrusion or the equilibrium read right, the bubble felt where it is breached -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then give the persona its form under Projection. Read it as the distance between persons doing work -- the zone that admits or holds off, the intrusion that presses too close, the equilibrium that pulls back as the other leans in -- never as a claim on a region. Delegate the claiming and marking of a place to the space engine, the mass of bodies as an environment to the crowd engine, and the intimacy the closeness signals to the self-disclosure engine.
